response: A detailed analysis of sputum and systemic inflammation in asthma phenotypes has revealed that a significant eosinophilic inflammation is present across all categories of asthma. This suggests that paucigranulocytic asthma, which was previously thought to be non-inflammatory, may actually be a low-grade inflammatory disease. In other words, paucigranulocytic asthmatics are not entirely non-inflammatory, but rather, they exhibit a lower level of inflammation compared to other asthma phenotypes. This finding highlights the complexity of asthma and the need for a more nuanced understanding of its various phenotypes and their underlying inflammatory mechanisms.
